name: Nat (row/column/counter/mask)
reason: coordinates and counters are numbers; not decomposed

name: Bool (flags)
reason: two-valued flag slot; it has no smaller components to decompose into

name: Dir
reason: four named directions; an enumeration with no internal structure that any rule decomposes

name: Blk
note: v2: slots t, l, big, face:Dir, box, item (face re-added in attempt 2: the eat rule reads the front half)

name: Act
note: v3: Act.mv carries turn, eat, half; Act.off also covers clicks on panels and room objects (observed free no-ops); the service accepts only actions 1,2,3,4,6

name: bstep (rules move/size/beam, incl. d_block, lead_face-up, e_refill eat)
stepB (counter, grid toggle, completion, refund, budget)
note: definition by cases on Act (lean/L4Model.lean); its case split is the Act coproduct

name: exit_win
note: the BRes.win branch of bstep (move or grow target meets the exit core); bstep = desc over the BAct coproduct, theorem L4.bstep_is_desc

name: grid_toggle / offgrid_click_free
note: the click and off branches of stepB, a definition by cases over the Act coproduct

name: eatsAt (e_refill v2: 2x2 overlap / 4x4 front overlap)
note: eatsAt = desc of eatSmall/eatBig, theorem L4.eatsAt_is_desc

name: slide / blocked move (v3: optional half step; turn on block)
note: definition L4.blocked, used inside the move branch of bstep; bstep = desc (L4.bstep_is_desc)

name: grow placement (R3 v4: (t-2,l-2) in all facings)
note: grow_generalized: copairing of the four facing cases = one rule; definitions grT/grL = 0 in L4Model
